description: Trigger precision eval: verify ue-perf-audit activates on trace-quality / performance-audit queries and NOT on static project audit, project health, deep profiling, or daemon memory queries (Issue #20596 mutual-delegation set)

cases.reason: Korean '성능 감사' — core trigger for the scored performance audit

cases.query: run a perf audit on the latest capture
validate trace before we analyze it
cases.reason: English 'validate trace' — Stage-1 op name as trigger
English 'performance audit' — differentiated from performance-health-check by its negative patterns
Static project health → performance-health-check (negative pattern '프로젝트 건강도')
Build time analysis → performance-health-check (negative pattern '빌드 시간')
Depth-first cause hunt → ue-insights-profiler (negative pattern 'why is my game slow')
Generic project audit → ue-audit ('audit' alone is not a perf-audit trigger)
